verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official, first-party Postman CLI. Its docs say it can run collections with reporters, start mock servers, generate SDKs, lint and check specs against governance rules, manage webhooks, and plug into CI/CD. It also explicitly gives coding agents CLI context for API discovery, code generation and maintenance, which fits the AI-native angle; a probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's use in AI-native or agent workflows.
